title: Milner Gardens and Woodland

services.name: Hours and admission
services.desc: Select the season you plan on visiting for the most accurate visiting hours and admission rates. Between the months of April to September, we offer public tours every Thursday and Friday from 1 pm to 2 pm starting at the Welcome Centre that are included in the cost of garden admission. If you are hoping for a private guided tour outside of the regularly scheduled public tour hours, please email us at milnergardens@viu.ca and we will do our best to accommodate your request. Please note that we only offer private tours on days we are open to the public with the exception of special events days. services.name: Five Visit program
services.desc: Join us for a year-long series of five field trips in our magical woodland garden and forest. Develop your students' core competencies in science while experiencing the benefits of outdoor learning and learning about the local environment.
